blurb: Guests can enjoy private winter experiences in heated gazebos or igloos overlooking the vineyard, featuring wine tastings, mulled wine, and charcuterie boards. The vineyard hosts various events including live music performances, yoga with wine, craft workshops, and group medium readings. The tasting room is housed in a historic 1830s barn and offers a wide selection of wines and gifts.
